title: Kings Puzzle
tagline: King Puzzle is a match-3 card game. Players match-3 to battle with players and the card could be your avatar or NFT game props.
description:
King Puzzle is a match-3 card game. Players match-3 to battle with players and the card could be your avatar or NFT game props. “King's Puzzles” is built on the success of “Against Wars”,
empowering the core gameplay functions with decentralized tokens, so that players can not only continue to enjoy the classic
puzzle RPGs, but also Web3 can offer players more
realistic value, by these technological advantages, “King's Puzzles”
can gain a huge advantage in the competition with the
“Puzzle and Dragons” and “Tower of Saviors”,
it will create a great chance to attract the old players of those games to deeply participate into our games.
how_its_made: We use NFT as gaming props and two different tokens for in-game players and governance token. The game is developed in Unity C# and the backend is based on Python. We are using IPFS/Filecoin to store the user preference data, Lens protocol as the user ID system. We also want to offer ENS domain name search to match and battle. The NFT will be based on Polygon.
